title: Source activity 1: Statistical question
instruction: A question answered by collecting and analysing data with variation.

title: Source activity 2: Statistical statement
instruction: A numerical claim/summary involving values, proportions, probabilities or predictions.

title: Source activity 3: Arithmetic mean
instruction: Sum of values divided by number of values.

title: Source activity 4: Median
instruction: Middle value after sorting; average the two middle values for even-sized data.
